meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,它会先运行 --list-tips 取真实提示列表,读你的 settings.json 判断你本人能看到哪些,再查对应源码核实机制,用你提问所用的语言给出深入解释。
howto.when: 当你问起某条 tip、某行 “Tip:” 是什么,或想知道自己能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那行 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会先取真实提示列表并读源码再解释。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些 tip?
Fable 5 拒绝后出现的那条 tip 是怎么运作的?

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, it runs --list-tips for the real list, reads your settings.json to see which tips you can see, then reads the source to verify the mechanism and explains it in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a tip, what a Tip: line means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What was that Tip: line I just saw?
say_en.note: It fetches the real tip list and reads the source first.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and says which tips you can meet.

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal work?
say_en.note: It walks the whole fallback-architect pipeline with file paths.
